description.value: AlHadbah Donair is a Middle Eastern restaurant on Robson Street in downtown Vancouver, serving shawerma wraps, kabab plates, falafel, and other Mediterranean fare made with halal meat. The restaurant has over 10 years of experience and emphasizes fresh, consistently prepared food. Its central location near Stanley Park and the seawall makes it a natural refuelling stop for cyclists in the area.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 11m; stands (2 spaces) at 27m; stands (5 spaces) at 59m; stands (2 spaces) at 75m; stands (2 spaces) at 84m. Total: 13 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content fully corroborates the OSM address (1610 Robson Street Unit #105, Vancouver, BC V6G 1C7) and phone number (604-568-6324), and the site's copyright year of 2026 plus an active menu page confirm the business is currently operating. Vegetarian options are explicitly stated on the website ('great variety for all diets including vegetarians') and the menu lists Vegetarian Plate, Falafel Plate, Grilled Veggie Wrap, and Falafel wraps. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those all remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant in downtown Vancouver with a current website and confirmed contact details; useful refuelling stop for touring cyclists.
